statement.zh-TW: 能計算應收款項、存貨、不動產廠房及設備與總資產的週轉率，並把週轉率換算成天數
statement.en: Calculate receivables turnover, inventory turnover, property, plant and equipment turnover and total asset turnover, and convert a turnover ratio into days

text.zh-TW: 把週轉率的分子分母顛倒，用餘額去除營收或成本
text.en: Inverting the turnover ratio, dividing the balance by revenue or cost

text.zh-TW: 以為天數是週轉率乘以一年的天數，而不是一年的天數除以週轉率
text.en: Thinking days equal turnover multiplied by the days in a year rather than the days in a year divided by turnover

text.zh-TW: 用營業收入當存貨週轉率的分子
text.en: Using revenue as the numerator of inventory turnover

statement.zh-TW: 能說明週轉率高低對資金壓力的意義，並在跨產業比較時考慮產業特性
statement.en: Explain what high or low turnover means for cash pressure, and allow for industry characteristics when comparing across industries

text.zh-TW: 以為週轉率永遠越高越好
text.en: Assuming higher turnover is always better

text.zh-TW: 以為平均收現日數變長代表客戶變多、生意變好
text.en: Thinking a longer collection period means more customers and better business

text.zh-TW: 拿不同產業的週轉率直接比高低
text.en: Comparing turnover ratios across different industries as if they were the same

statement.zh-TW: 能計算營運槓桿度與財務槓桿度，並用「變動百分比被放大幾倍」解讀：營收變動的百分比，被放大成營業利益變動的百分比；營業利益變動的百分比，被放大成稅前淨利變動的百分比
statement.en: Calculate the degree of operating leverage and the degree of financial leverage and read them as magnified percentage changes: the percentage change in revenue is magnified into the percentage change in operating profit, and the percentage change in operating profit into the percentage change in profit before tax

text.zh-TW: 用金額解讀槓桿度，以為營收每多一元營業利益就多幾元
text.en: Reading leverage in money terms, as if each extra dollar of revenue added several dollars of operating profit

text.zh-TW: 把財務槓桿度的終點當成現金或營業收入，而不是稅前淨利
text.en: Taking cash or revenue, rather than profit before tax, as the end point of financial leverage

text.zh-TW: 以為槓桿度高一定是好事，忘了它同樣放大虧損
text.en: Assuming high leverage is always good, forgetting that it magnifies losses just as much

statement.zh-TW: 能說明應付款項週轉率在課程 Excel 版（本期進貨）與年報版（銷貨成本）的分子差異，並依題目指定的版本計算
statement.en: Explain the difference between the numerators of payables turnover in the course Excel version (purchases) and the annual-report version (cost of sales), and calculate it in the version a question specifies

text.zh-TW: 以為兩種版本算出來的數字一定相同
text.en: Thinking the two versions must give the same figure

text.zh-TW: 用營業收入當應付款項週轉率的分子
text.en: Using revenue as the numerator of payables turnover

text.zh-TW: 以為應付帳款為零時週轉率是零
text.en: Thinking payables turnover is zero when there are no trade payables
